title: TSS_iEEG
description: This dataset comprises intracranial EEG (iEEG) recordings from 7 participants who underwent closed-loop stimulation targeting theta oscillations in hippocampal networks. The data support an investigation into how closed-loop control of theta rhythms modulates human hippocampal network connectivity, encompassing pre- and post-stimulation evoked potentials, resting-state periods, and stimulation epochs (closed-loop and control). Electrode locations are provided in MNI152 2009c asymmetrical template space.
methods_description: Raw iEEG data were recorded in BrainVision format (vhdr, vmrk, eeg) and organized according to the BIDS iEEG specification. Each subject's data are segmented into pre-stimulation and post-stimulation evoked potentials, pre- and post-stimulation rest periods, closed-loop stimulation, and control stimulation. Electrode coordinates were registered to the MNI152 2009c asymmetrical template. Data were converted to BIDS using the FieldTrip data2bids converter.

funding_references.funder_name: National Institute Of Neurological Disorders and Stroke
